The empire ruled by Julius Caesar was the Roman Empire.

The genre of the document is fantasy or science fiction. This is determined by the presence of specific textual characteristics such as the description of a "fiery landscape" and "desolate earth," the personification of the sky "weeping," and the mention of a hostile force called "the Scourge." These elements, combined with the narrative focus on a protagonist named Aric preparing for a battle for "existence" against an overwhelming threat, are hallmarks of speculative fiction genres.
